scope: Front-page publisher templates visually inspected; per-document timestamp, matchup, date, season and prior-record/game-number checks are mandatory. This is not manual fact-checking of every sentence or approval of entire packets.
selection: One passing archived front-page packet per game; prefer more extractable words, then publisher and source hash. Never use outcomes or model scores for document selection.
